questions.title: Circles Configuration 1: Chord Metric at D1
questions.stem: In a circle of radius $R = 5\text{ cm}$, chord $AB$ subtends an angle $\theta = 60^\circ$ at the circumference. If point $P$ lies on the minor arc, determine the distance metric $d = 3\text{ cm}$ and evaluate the governing Power of Point $P$.
questions.trap_warning: Assuming inscribed angle equals central angle directly (forgetting factor of 2).
hint_ladder: Tier 1 (Conceptual Nudge): Apply the Inscribed Angle Theorem relating central and subtended angles.
Tier 2 (Tactical Step): Set up the isosceles triangle with vertices at the circle center and chord endpoints.
Tier 3 (Crux Move): Solve the trigonometric chord relation $L = 2R \sin(\theta)$.
reasoning_steps: Step 1: The central angle subtended by chord AB is 2 * 60° = 120°.
Step 2: Chord length L = 2 * R * sin(60°) = 2 * 5 * (sqrt(3)/2).
Step 3: Power of point evaluates to -16.
questions.independent_check: Verified via analytic Cartesian coordinate geometry.

hint_ladder: Tier 1 (Conceptual Nudge): Apply the Inscribed Angle Theorem relating central and subtended angles.
Tier 2 (Tactical Step): Set up the isosceles triangle with vertices at the circle center and chord endpoints.
Tier 3 (Crux Move): Solve the trigonometric chord relation $L = 2R \sin(\theta)$.
reasoning_steps: Step 1: The central angle subtended by chord AB is 2 * 60° = 120°.
Step 2: Chord length L = 2 * R * sin(60°) = 2 * 33 * (sqrt(3)/2).
Step 3: Power of point evaluates to -128.
questions.independent_check: Verified via analytic Cartesian coordinate geometry.
